lines: Rows retired from [the active ledger](../network-pawn-state.md): superseded by a

fields.claim: Offline 3.0.32 restore sends 90 pawn stats (16 changed, 32 added; key 58 to 222). Record 2's starting, equipped, module item, set-bonus and modifier grants via F-839 formulas, Base pass-throughs give 57; 23 unread formulas, weight/held-tool state and gear attachments' grants remain

Pinned 3.0.32 declares 1004 virtual stats; F-983's 23 keep 3.0.31's inputs and read as pass-throughs, capped sums and tool, time, atmosphere, mount or encumbrance selections; native models them: 58 of record 2's 90 restored stats equal, each other one needing an unmodelled source

Record 2's remaining restored-stat grants are equipped gear's attachments: the items in the C016 inventories their property 13 names, each granting its Attachments row's D_Alterations Stats; with them 70 of 90 equal; overencumbrance, the held tool and scaled modifier grants remain

3.0.32 scales a modifier's grant v as sign * CeilToInt(abs((E + 100) * v * 0.01f)), E its final effectiveness, and adds Overburdened (row 21) while WeightCapacity_+ * 1000 < its inventories' CurrentWeight sum; with both, 89 of record 2's 90 restored stats equal

Pinned 3.0.32 RecalculateWeight adds 1 per item (not stack) matching D_TagQueries rows 13, 59, 57, 60, 58 (Any_Tool, AnimalCorpse, Radar, Exotic, Extractor) to stats 420, 419, 421, 422, 423 as the inventory's source; record 2's six Item.Tool items give its IsCarryingTool_? 6

Native stat_restore models a returning pawn's restored stats from F-983 to F-987's sources through F-984's formulas: for record 2 all 90 equal run init-03's after its restore bunch; the restore update does not send them yet
fields.scope_and_limits: high; offline model; item IDs, keys and stat-bounded state not modelled

fields.claim: Native restore sends stat deltas and bounds (F-988); record 2 matches init-03. Incomplete inventory/modifier/stat inputs withhold stats and dependent saved levels; independent fields remain
